title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Standing and the Credit Builder AutoPay Due Day
content:
When AutoPay is turned on again on a Credit Builder account, days are added to the account's current due day when the borrower's Larkspur FlexLine shows payment trouble. The facts are read from the borrower's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit records: the line's ledger of returned-payment entries, and the line's status and amount past due.

## Standing test

When a payment on any of the borrower's Larkspur FlexLines was returned in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a line dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the FlexLine-return buffer is added; when none was returned but the borrower's FlexLine in active or frozen status shows an amount past due, the FlexLine past-due buffer; otherwise no FlexLine buffer.

| Borrower's FlexLine | Days added to the due day |
|---|---|
| a payment returned within the 12 months | FlexLine-return buffer: 2 days |
| no return within the 12 months; the line, in active or frozen status, shows an amount past due | FlexLine past-due buffer: 1 day |
| neither, or no FlexLine | none |

## Edge of the 12 months (hypothetical dates)

Today 3 December: a FlexLine return dated 3 December of the previous year falls outside the 12 months; one dated 4 December of the previous year is counted.
